ValidationRule.description: Requirement 3: no change to a session during the 24 hours before it starts, or after it has started. Uses the start time as it was before the edit
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( ISNEW() ), PRIORVALUE( Start_Time__c ) - NOW() < 1, OR( ISCHANGED( Start_Time__c ), ISCHANGED( End_Time__c ), ISCHANGED( Venue__c ), ISCHANGED( Trainer__c ), ISCHANGED( Course__c ), ISCHANGED( Status__c ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This session starts in less than 24 hours (or has already started) and can no longer be changed.
